single_changed_variable: fixed-horizon exit is replaced by a frozen causal harvest target with 384-bar max age
entry_contract: same seven-pair V9 signal_id, direction, and next executable BID/ASK fill; source score/outcome fields are ignored

target_training.data: only tuning entries whose complete 384-bar observation and next executable exit are before 2026-05-01
target_training.statistic: per-pair nearest-rank Q35 of maximum favorable signed mid-close ratio within 384 completed M5 bars
target_training.fallback: global Q35 only if a pair has fewer than 20 eligible tuning entries

exit_contract.harvest: when a completed M5 close first reaches the entry-time frozen target, exit at the next recorded BID/ASK open
exit_contract.max_age: if never reached, exit at the next recorded BID/ASK open after 384 completed M5 bars

cost_arms: same V7-V11 RAW_SIGNAL, EXECUTABLE_BASE, ADVERSE_STRESS assumptions
period_membership: both fill and exit must be inside the declared period
development_admission: walk-forward RAW_SIGNAL, EXECUTABLE_BASE, and ADVERSE_STRESS mean returns are all positive
